store_prompts.description:
Whether user prompts are stored in the ledger. Defaults to `false`: prompts are never
stored unless this is enabled.

SpecVersion.description:
The `spec` field of a document: the version of the ACS spec it was written against.

The only supported value is `"acs/0.1"`. Readers MUST reject any other value.

claim_ttl_secs.description: Seconds a claim stays live without a heartbeat before it expires.

default_target_branch.description: The branch work is integrated into when a seat's own target is not known.

spec.description: The spec version the policy is written against. Always `acs/0.1`.

sync_interval_secs.description: Seconds between background syncs of claims and ledger with the git remote.
